datasets.name: prospects
queryLines: SELECT company, tier, risk_score AS score, CASE WHEN company RLIKE '\\.edu|\\.ac\\.|univ|school|college' THEN 'Education' WHEN company RLIKE '\\.gov|\\.gob\\.|\\.go\\.|\\.mil' THEN 'Government' WHEN company RLIKE 'health|hospital|clinic|medic|pharma' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN company RLIKE 'bank|financ|insur|invest|credit' THEN 'Finance' ELSE 'Business' END AS sector, country, ips, network_org, CASE greatest(s_compromised, s_unauth_data, s_kev, s_ransomware, s_high_epss, s_remote, s_database, s_industrial, s_open_dir, s_ntlm, s_eol, s_cert, s_legacy_tls, s_self_signed, s_no_hsts) WHEN s_compromised THEN 'Already compromised' WHEN s_unauth_data THEN 'Data open without password' WHEN s_kev THEN 'Known-exploited CVE' WHEN s_ransomware THEN 'Ransomware-linked CVE' WHEN s_high_epss THEN 'Likely-exploited CVE (EPSS)' WHEN s_remote THEN 'Remote access exposed' WHEN s_database THEN 'Database exposed' WHEN s_industrial THEN 'Industrial control exposed' WHEN s_open_dir THEN 'Open directory' WHEN s_ntlm THEN 'Leaks internal names' WHEN s_eol THEN 'End-of-life software' WHEN s_cert THEN 'Expired certificate' WHEN s_legacy_tls THEN 'Old TLS versions' WHEN s_self_signed THEN 'Self-signed certs' WHEN s_no_hsts THEN 'No HSTS' END AS top_reason, array_join(exposed_services, ', ') AS exposed_services, array_join(slice(kev_list, 1, 3), ', ') AS known_exploited_cves FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects WHERE tier <> 'Low signal'

datasets.name: kpis
queryLines: SELECT count(*) AS accounts, count_if(tier = 'Breached / data exposed') AS breached, count_if(tier = 'Actively exploited CVE') AS exploited, count_if(tier = 'Exposed critical service') AS exposed FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects WHERE tier <> 'Low signal'

datasets.name: tiers
queryLines: SELECT tier, count(*) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects GROUP BY tier

datasets.name: countries
queryLines: SELECT country, count(*) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects WHERE tier <> 'Low signal' AND country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY companies DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: signals
queryLines: SELECT 'Already compromised' AS signal, count_if(s_compromised > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Data open without password' AS signal, count_if(s_unauth_data > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Known-exploited CVE' AS signal, count_if(s_kev > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Ransomware-linked CVE' AS signal, count_if(s_ransomware > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Likely-exploited CVE (EPSS)' AS signal, count_if(s_high_epss > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Remote access exposed' AS signal, count_if(s_remote > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Database exposed' AS signal, count_if(s_database > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Industrial control exposed' AS signal, count_if(s_industrial > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Open directory' AS signal, count_if(s_open_dir > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Leaks internal names' AS signal, count_if(s_ntlm > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'End-of-life software' AS signal, count_if(s_eol > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Expired certificate' AS signal, count_if(s_cert > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Old TLS versions' AS signal, count_if(s_legacy_tls > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'Self-signed certs' AS signal, count_if(s_self_signed > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'No HSTS' AS signal, count_if(s_no_hsts > 0) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects

datasets.name: services
queryLines: SELECT service, count(*) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects LATERAL VIEW explode(exposed_services) s AS service GROUP BY service ORDER BY companies DESC LIMIT 12

datasets.name: cves
queryLines: SELECT cve, count(*) AS companies FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_prospects LATERAL VIEW explode(kev_list) c AS cve GROUP BY cve ORDER BY companies DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: quality
queryLines: WITH h AS (SELECT breached, 25 * coalesce(kev, false)::INT + 10 * coalesce(high_epss, false)::INT + 12 * coalesce(remote, false)::INT + 8 * coalesce(eol, false)::INT + 6 * coalesce(cert_expired, false)::INT + 5 * coalesce(legacy_tls, false)::INT + 3 * coalesce(self_signed, false)::INT + 6 * coalesce(anon_ftp, false)::INT + 5 * coalesce(ntlm, false)::INT + -8 * coalesce(waf, false)::INT + -10 * coalesce(security_txt, false)::INT AS score FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts), r AS (SELECT breached, rank() OVER (ORDER BY score) + (count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY score) - 1) / 2.0 AS rk FROM h) SELECT round((sum(rk) FILTER (WHERE breached) - count_if(breached) * (count_if(breached) + 1) / 2.0) / (count_if(breached) * count_if(NOT breached)), 3) AS auc, count_if(breached) AS breached_servers, count(*) AS servers FROM r

datasets.name: lift
queryLines: SELECT 'Known-exploited CVE' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE kev) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Likely-exploited CVE' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE high_epss) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Remote access exposed' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE remote) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'End-of-life software' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE eol) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Expired certificate' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE cert_expired) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Old TLS versions' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE legacy_tls) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Self-signed certs' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE self_signed) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Anonymous FTP' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE anon_ftp) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Leaks internal names' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE ntlm) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Behind a WAF' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE waf) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts UNION ALL SELECT 'Publishes security.txt' AS signal, round(avg(breached::INT) FILTER (WHERE security_txt) / avg(breached::INT), 2) AS lift FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.gold_eval_hosts

datasets.name: removed
queryLines: SELECT CASE rule WHEN 'generated_hostnames' THEN 'Reverse-DNS domains' WHEN 'not_claimed' THEN 'Failed ownership check' WHEN 'subdomain_platform' THEN 'Dynamic DNS / shared hosting' ELSE 'Provider brand or name' END AS reason, count(*) AS domains FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.silver_infra_domains GROUP BY rule UNION ALL SELECT 'Network providers (orgs)', count(*) FROM databricks_demo_ws.cyber.silver_providers

lines: Companies ranked by how urgently their internet-facing systems need security help, from **14.6M internet-scan records**.
Every score is the sum of named signals, so each account comes with its reason to call. IPs are never shown.

frame.title: Why now: accounts by tier
frame.description: Tier = the single strongest reason. Breached beats exploited beats exposed.

frame.title: Accounts to call first
frame.description: Sorted by score; filter above. Click a column to re-sort.

lines: Counts of prospects showing each signal. Urgent signals (breached, exploited) score most; hygiene signals score least.

frame.title: Services exposed to the internet
frame.description: Counted only when the protocol actually answered, never from the probe name.

frame.title: Most common known-exploited CVEs
frame.description: CVEs on 5%+ of vulnerable hosts are mostly version-number false matches and are down-weighted in the score.

lines: Back-test: every server is scored **without** the breach signals, then we check whether servers that were actually
breached (compromised tag or open database) rank higher. AUC 0.5 = random, 1.0 = perfect.

frame.title: How much more often servers with each signal were breached
frame.description: 1.0 = no effect. Only ~56 labelled breaches, so read as direction, not precision.

frame.title: Infrastructure removed before scoring
frame.description: Rules learned from the data, not a blocklist: they get more accurate as more files arrive.
